title: Allocate Mailboxes
description: Minimize total distance from houses to the nearest mailbox by placing k mailboxes.
pseudocode:
1. houses.sort()
2. cost[i][j] = calculate_cost(i, j)
3. dp[k][i] = min(dp[k-1][j] + cost[j+1][i])
4. return dp[k][n-1]

steps.note: Calculate cost for range [0, 1]: median is 1 or 4, cost |1-1| + |4-1| = 3
Solve for k=1: cost to place 1 mailbox for all houses [1, 4, 8, 10] is 9
Solve for k=2: split at index 1. Min cost: cost(0,1) + cost(2,3) = 3 + 2 = 5
